title: The Store That Builds Itself
subtitle: When System 3 Came to Work
running_head: CHAPTER 11 · THE STORE THAT BUILDS ITSELF
opener_note: STALE ASSET: art carries old numbering (Chapter 10). Regeneration job in art-prompts; draft uses it for palette continuity.

slots.anchor: Imagine two customers looking at the same product page.
slots.brief: Corner scene: two shop windows side by side displaying the identical jacket — before one, a woman with five days of visible deliberation around her (notes, returned visits marked as footprints); before the other, a man who arrived ten seconds ago, still holding a search-result ticket. Same glass, different questions.

slots.anchor: But consider the customer who is switching
slots.brief: Margin vignette: Mei at a small table, two trail shoes circling her head like orbiting moons on drawn orbit-lines, fourth loop marked with a small tally. Tired but fond.

slots.anchor: The carousel has become the fruit bowl of ecommerce
slots.brief: Small spot: an ornate carousel shrunken to sit as a fruit bowl on a sideboard table, oranges riding the horses. Deadpan domestic.

slots.anchor: ## Sami Does Not Need a Click
slots.brief: Margin vignette: Sami at a threshold with one shoe half-tried-on, a paper size chart unfolded twice over, the doorway to 'add to bag' glowing gently and unentered. The blocker is confidence, not choice.

slots.anchor: ## The Trace Is Part of the Intelligence
slots.brief: Corner scene: an archive room where each served page hangs as a card with its full deliberation attached beneath — and one long drawer labeled only by its fullness: the losers, kept. A robot archivist re-files a rejected candidate with respect.

slots.text: If your ecosystem rewards clicks, clickable organisms evolve.

slots.anchor: ## The Book Comes Back to Bite Me
slots.text: A philosophy of emergence should be willing to lose an A/B test.
